* Sample information

Read metadata
````{r}
sampInfo <- read_csv(here("doc/metadataZE_mRNA_miRNA.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
````

Combine with path to salmon quant
```{r}
samples <- sampInfo %>% 
  mutate(StageType = paste0(Type, "_", Stage)) %>% 
  left_join(data.frame(Filenames = list.files(here("data/analysis/mRNA/salmon_ZE"), recursive = TRUE, pattern = "quant.sf", full.names = TRUE)) %>% 
              mutate(SampleID = basename(dirname(Filenames)) %>% gsub("_merged_sortmerna_trimmomatic","",.) %>% gsub("_S[0-9].*$","",.)),
            by = "SampleID") %>% 
  mutate(StageType = factor(StageType, levels = c(paste0("SD_",1:3),
                                                  "ZE_4","FG_4",
                                                  "ZE_5","FG_5",
                                                  "ZE_6","FG_6",
                                                  "ZE_7","FG_7",
                                                  "ZE_8-9","FG_8-9",
                                                  "ZE_10","FG_10")),
         Stage = factor(as.character(Stage), levels = as.character(c(1:7,"8-9",10))))
```

# Sample overview

Read the expression at the gene level
````{r}
txi <- suppressMessages(tximport(files = samples$Filenames,
                                 type = "salmon",
                                 tx2gene=tx2gene))
counts <- txi$counts
colnames(counts) <- samples$SampleID
````

Since the salmon quant file contains both genes and pseudogenes, I will plot per-gene mean expression of each category

````{r}
dat <- data.frame(value=log10(rowMeans(counts))) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("id") %>% 
  mutate(group = ifelse(grepl("^PA_",id),"gene","TEandPseudogene"))
ggplot(dat, aes(x=value, group=group, col=group)) + 
  geom_density(na.rm = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("gene mean raw counts distribution") +
  scale_x_continuous(name="per gene mean raw counts (log10)") + 
  theme_bw()
````

`r emoji("point_right")` **The cumulative coverage on genes is as expected.**

Per-sample plot
````{r}
dat <- as.data.frame(log10(counts)) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("id") %>% 
  mutate(group = ifelse(grepl("^PA_",id),"gene","TEandPseudogene")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = setdiff(colnames(.),c("id","group"))) %>% 
  mutate(StageType=samples$StageType[match(name,samples$SampleID)])

ggplot(dat,aes(x=value,group=name,col=StageType)) + 
  geom_density(na.rm = TRUE) + 
  facet_grid(row = vars(group), scale = "free") +
  ggtitle("sample raw counts distribution") +
  scale_x_continuous(name="per gene raw counts (log10)") + 
  theme_bw()
````

All looks fine. I will remove pseudogene and TE out from the count table and skip most of BioQA since the quality of this data has been assessed multiple times already.
````{r, warning=FALSE}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(
  txi=txi,
  colData = samples,
  design = ~ StageType)

colnames(dds) <- samples$SampleID

dds <- dds[rownames(dds)[grepl("^PA_",rownames(dds))],colnames(dds)[!colnames(counts) == "P11562_112"]]

saveRDS(dds,file=here("data/analysis/mRNA/flipComp_dds_spruce_ZE.rds"))
````

```{r}
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds) %>% 
  suppressMessages()

vst <- assay(varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds, blind=TRUE))
vst <- vst - min(vst)
saveRDS(vst, here("data/analysis/mRNA/flipComp_mRNA_ZE_nonmodelaware-vst.rds"))

boxplot(split(t(normalizationFactors(dds)),dds$StageType),las=2,
        main="Sequencing libraries size factor by Stage")
```

````{r}
pc <- prcomp(t(vst))
percent <- round(summary(pc)$importance[2,]*100)

p <- pca(vst,colData(dds))

pc.dat <- bind_cols(PC1=pc$x[,1],
                    PC2=pc$x[,2],
                    PC3=pc$x[,3],
                    PC4=pc$x[,4],
                    PC5=pc$x[,5],
                    PC6=pc$x[,6],
                    PC7=pc$x[,7],
                    PC8=pc$x[,8],
                    PC9=pc$x[,9],
                    PC10=pc$x[,10],
                    as.data.frame(colData(dds)))
````


````{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 5}
p1 <- ggplot(pc.dat, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, fill=StageType)) + 
  geom_point(size=5, shape = 21, color = "grey50", stroke = 0.5) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = anncol[["StageType"]]) +
  ggtitle("Principal Component Analysis", subtitle="variance stabilized counts") +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (",percent[1],"%)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (",percent[2],"%)")) +
  theme_bw()

p2 <- ggplot(pc.dat, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, fill=Stage, shape=Type)) + 
  geom_point(size=5, color = "grey50", stroke = 0.5) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("SD" = 21, "FG" = 22, "ZE" = 24)) +
  ggtitle("Principal Component Analysis", subtitle="variance stabilized counts") +
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (",percent[1],"%)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (",percent[2],"%)")) +
  theme_bw()

p1 + p2
````

# Prepare data

Make annotations
```{r}
annotCol <- samples %>% 
  dplyr::select(StageType) %>% 
  mutate(StageType = as.character(StageType)) %>% 
  as.data.frame()
rownames(annotCol) <- samples$SampleID
```

The comparison will be made between adjacent stages SD_1 vs SD_2, SD_2 vs SD_3, and so on. All comparisons are as follow
```{r}
comp <- list(
  "SD2_vs_SD1"    = list(treatment = "SD_2"  , control = "SD_1"  ),
  "SD3_vs_SD2"    = list(treatment = "SD_3"  , control = "SD_2"  ),
  "ZE4_vs_SD3"    = list(treatment = "ZE_4"  , control = "SD_3"  ),
  "ZE5_vs_ZE4"    = list(treatment = "ZE_5"  , control = "ZE_4"  ),
  "ZE6_vs_ZE5"    = list(treatment = "ZE_6"  , control = "ZE_5"  ),
  "ZE7_vs_ZE6"    = list(treatment = "ZE_7"  , control = "ZE_6"  ),
  "ZE8-9_vs_ZE7"  = list(treatment = "ZE_8-9", control = "ZE_7"  ),
  "ZE10_vs_ZE8-9" = list(treatment = "ZE_10" , control = "ZE_8-9"),
  "FG4_vs_SD3"    = list(treatment = "FG_4"  , control = "SD_3"  ),
  "FG5_vs_FG4"    = list(treatment = "FG_5"  , control = "FG_4"  ),
  "FG6_vs_FG5"    = list(treatment = "FG_6"  , control = "FG_5"  ),
  "FG7_vs_FG6"    = list(treatment = "FG_7"  , control = "FG_6"  ),
  "FG8-9_vs_FG7"  = list(treatment = "FG_8-9", control = "FG_7"  ),
  "FG10_vs_FG8-9" = list(treatment = "FG_10" , control = "FG_8-9"))
knitr::kable(bind_rows(comp, .id = "comparison"))
```

# DEseq2 on mRNA

## DE results and violin plots

Here I will loop over all comparisons. The results will be filtered based on a FDR threshold of 0.01 and a minimum log2FC of 0.5.
```{r, message=FALSE}
resultsList <- comp %>%
  map(unlist) %>%
  imap(~ apply_extract_results(dds=dds, samples=samples,
                               comparison=.x, default_prefix=.y,
                               NameConditionColumn="StageType",
                               variables_interest="StageType",
                               lfc=0.5, padj=0.01, export=TRUE,
                               default_dir=here("data/analysis/mRNA")))
```

## Other plots

Pulling DE mRNAs ids and filter for genes (id starting with PA_)
```{r}
resultsNames <- resultsList %>% 
  map(~ .x[["res"]]) %>% 
  map(as.data.frame) %>% 
  map(rownames_to_column, "id") %>% 
  map(~ mutate(.x, sig = ifelse(is.na(padj),"ns",
                         ifelse(padj < 0.01 & log2FoldChange > 0.5, "up",
                         ifelse(padj < 0.01 & log2FoldChange < -0.5, "dn","ns"))))) %>%
  map(~ split(.x, f=.x$sig)) %>%
  map(~ map(.x, pull, "id")) %>%
  map(discard_at, at = "ns") %>% 
  transpose(.names = c("up","dn")) %>% 
  map(~ map(.x, ~ .x[grepl("^PA_", .x)]))
```

Save data
```{r}
saveRDS(list("res" = resultsList,
             "names" = resultsNames),
        here("data/analysis/mRNA/flipComp_mRNA_ZE_ddsResults.rds"))
```

### Heatmaps of DE mRNAs

These heatmaps are from non-model-aware vst-normalized expression values

```{r}
annotDE <- resultsNames %>%
  map(map, as.data.frame) %>%
  map(bind_rows, .id = "Comparison") %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "DE") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(id = `.x[[i]]`) %>% 
  split(., f = .$Comparison) %>% 
  map(dplyr::select, -Comparison) %>% 
  map(remove_rownames) %>%
  map(column_to_rownames,"id")


iwalk(annotDE, function(a,n){
  if(nrow(a) == 1){
    mat <- vst[rownames(vst) %in% rownames(a),] %>% 
      t() %>% 
      as.matrix()
    rownames(mat) <- rownames(a)
    
    hm <- pheatmap(mat,
                 color = viridis(20),
                 annotation_col = annotCol,
                 annotation_row = a,
                 annotation_colors = anncol,
                 border_color = NA,
                 #cluster_cols = FALSE,
                 cluster_rows = FALSE,
                 show_rownames = FALSE,
                 labels_col = samples$SampleName,
                 angle_col = 90,
                 legend = TRUE,
                 main = paste0("non-modelaware vst: ", n))
    hm
  } else {
    mat <- vst[rownames(vst) %in% rownames(a),]
    
    hm <- pheatmap(mat,
                 color = viridis(20),
                 annotation_col = annotCol,
                 annotation_row = a,
                 annotation_colors = anncol,
                 border_color = NA,
                 #cluster_cols = FALSE,
                 show_rownames = FALSE,
                 clustering_method = "ward.D2",
                 labels_col = samples$SampleName,
                 angle_col = 90,
                 legend = TRUE,
                 main = paste0("non-modelaware vst: ", n))
    hm
  }
})
```

### Jaccard Index

Jaccard Index is count of intersection divide by count of the union. This will normalize by the number of members in each set
```{r}
dat <- c(
  setNames(resultsNames[["up"]],paste(names(resultsNames[["up"]]), "Up")),
  setNames(resultsNames[["dn"]],paste(names(resultsNames[["dn"]]), "Down")))

mat <- matrix(data=0,nrow=length(dat),ncol=length(dat),dimnames = list(names(dat),names(dat)))

for(i in 1:length(dat)){
  for(j in 1:length(dat)){
    rn <- rownames(mat)[i]
    cn <- colnames(mat)[j]
    
    nIntersect <- intersect(dat[[rn]],dat[[cn]])
    nUnion <- union(dat[[rn]],dat[[cn]])
    
    mat[i,j] <- length(nIntersect)/length(nUnion)
    }
}

pheatmap(mat,
         cluster_rows = F,
         cluster_cols = F,
         display_numbers = T,
         number_format = "%.2f",
         main = "Jaccard index of DE mRNAs")
```
